## Featured projects

### [deep-researcher](https://github.com/jadenstock/deep-researcher)

An agentic deep-research system built on pydantic-ai. A top-level researcher agent scouts the terrain, then dispatches analyst sub-agents (which dispatch their own scouts) against focused sub-questions. Agents share a note graph, and every claim in the final report traces back to a verbatim quote from a source they actually read. Includes cross-model-family verification and a live WebSocket UI.

### [whittling-planner](https://github.com/jadenstock/whittling-planner)

CAM for a person with a knife. Pick a block of wood and a design, and it plans how to orient the block, how to mark it with a pencil and ruler, and what to carve at each stage, shown in 3D. Designs are signed distance functions, and a grain check flags short-grain weak spots. It also has a gallery of 19 designs and a guide to the knife cuts.

### [hex-tic-tac-toe](https://github.com/jadenstock/hex-tic-tac-toe)

A web app for hexagonal tic-tac-toe on an infinite pan-and-zoom board, with six in a row to win. It has live multiplayer over WebSockets on an AWS backend, and I wrote greedy and MCTS bots for it.
